summary: Master Enterprise Content Management Systems with our expert-led training course. Gain essential skills to streamline content processes in your organization.
lede: Enterprise content management organizes digital documents and records across repositories, with controls for metadata, workflows, access, retention, and disposal. This training is for professionals who govern, configure, secure, migrate, or audit content; they practice profiling repositories, designing information architecture and metadata, and modeling controlled workflows and security measures.
audienceIntro: This enterprise content management course is designed for professionals who govern, configure, secure, migrate, or audit digital content. It suits hands-on practitioners, technical specialists, operational managers, and governance leaders who need to connect repository capabilities with records, metadata, security, and workflow requirements.
modules: Enterprise Content Management Foundations with ISO 15489
Enterprise Content Management Assessment with ISO 30301
Enterprise Content Management Architecture in SharePoint
ECM Workflow Automation and AI Classification
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Practical exposure to document management, records, compliance, information governance, or digital collaboration environments. Programming requirement: No coding is required. Spreadsheet skills support the inventory and dashboard exercises. Depth: Metadata, workflow, repository architecture, controls, and governance receive operational application. AI classification, CMIS integration, and enterprise migration engineering receive conceptual and planning-level coverage. Equipment: Bring a laptop capable of running a spreadsheet application and viewing supplied course files.
